title: KitchenAid Mini Chopper £49, Ring Doorbell 2K £39.99 and Dyson Clean+Wash £239
description: Black Friday weekend UK deals: KitchenAid Mini Chopper £49, Ring Battery Doorbell 2K £39.99, Dyson Clean+Wash £239 and Fire TV Stick 4K £31.99.
intro:
**Black Friday itself is over, but most of the big prices are still live this weekend.** The standout today is the KitchenAid Mini Food Chopper at £49 on Amazon, which matches its lowest price, along with the Ring Battery Video Doorbell 2K at half price (£39.99) and the Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene at £239. For the kitchen, the Ninja Crispi is still £99 and the Philips Baristina coffee bundle is £299.99.

Every price below comes from UK deal coverage dated 27 November (TechRadar's UK Black Friday live blog and T3's live deals page), so check the final price at checkout. Buy now or wait? Now, for anything here: Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday (30 November), and these are the same prices that have held all week, so there is little to gain by waiting and a real chance of stock running out.

deals.name: KitchenAid Mini Food Chopper (3.5 cup)
deals.note: A small, sturdy chopper for onions, herbs, dips and baby food, and it matches its lowest price so far. A good gift for anyone who cooks; see our [KitchenAid Black Friday deals](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide for the stand mixers.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi 3.8L glass air fryer
deals.note: The glass air fryer you can cook in and store leftovers in, at its lowest price yet. Best for one or two people; bigger households should look at the dual-basket models in our [air fryer Black Friday deals](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips Baristina espresso machine + milk frother bundle
deals.note: A compact bean-to-cup that grinds, tamps and brews from one lever, with a separate frother for lattes. £80 off the bundle; compare it with the other machines in our [bean-to-cup coffee machine deals](/guides/bean-to-cup-coffee-machine-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene wet floor cleaner
deals.note: Dyson's hard-floor mop is still at the lower price it dropped to on Black Friday. Worth it for homes with lots of tiles or laminate. See our [Black Friday vacuum deals](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight for cordless and robot options.

deals.name: Philips ReAura LED face mask
deals.note: £100 off Philips' at-home LED mask. A pricey treat, so it suits someone already sold on LED skincare rather than a curious first try.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell 2K
deals.note: Half price, and battery-powered, so no wiring needed. Remember that recordings need a Ring Home subscription. More in our [Ring doorbell Black Friday deals](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Camera 2K
deals.note: Half price for an indoor camera you can turn from your phone to see the whole room. Handy for keeping an eye on pets.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K
deals.note: The easiest way to upgrade an older TV, back at its usual sale price. Our [Fire TV Stick deals](/guides/fire-tv-stick-deals-uk/) guide explains which model to choose.

deals.name: Bose SoundLink Flex (2nd Gen) Bluetooth speaker
deals.note: A tough, waterproof speaker that sounds bigger than it looks. Around £57 off, and a safe gift for teenagers or anyone who likes music in the kitchen or garden.

deals.name: Lego Up-Scaled Santa (40820)
deals.note: A chunky Santa figure that doubles as a Christmas decoration, £14 off. See our [Lego Black Friday deals](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) for bigger sets.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not for these. Amazon's Black Friday Week ends on Cyber Monday, 30 November, and retailers rarely cut further on the final day; if anything, popular items sell out. See [when is Cyber Monday 2026 UK](/guides/when-is-cyber-monday-2026-uk/) for what to expect on Monday, and our [Black Friday live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/) for the wider list.

We've left out deals we couldn't pin to a price today, including the upgraded Shark Stratos cordless and the Ninja PowerPod bundle, which deal sites listed without a confirmed UK price. The Lego Game Boy has sold out at Amazon.

## This week's spotlight

Our [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight covers the cordless, robot and wet floor cleaners worth buying and what to pay. Also see [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/).

Not a Prime member? Some Amazon deal prices need Prime, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the rest of Black Friday Week. For everything else, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
